prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1005; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents our client in connection with a rear-end collision that occurred while our client was stopped in traffic. Our client sustained injuries in the collision and is now seeking medical care and compensation for the losses that followed. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. We ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with any other coverage that may apply. We also request that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including the claim file, photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any dashcam or telematics information. Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and provide your claim reference number so that we may proceed efficiently.
